report.scoping: This report covers all covered markets for August 2026. It is drawn from 142 projects and 126 captured records. Of those projects, 15 are described in full, selected by significance; 39 further projects are counted but not described; 59 projects filed nothing in this period; and 29 carry no market or region we could resolve. 2 projects whose every record has been dismissed are excluded entirely, because they have no filing to cite. A further 32 projects in this geography are excluded because our capture holds no published name for them; the coverage note says where. Anything outside that geography or period is not covered here.
